description: Sign in to the CAPPZ marketplace (needed to publish). --signup creates the account; a person must confirm the email (human step), and --wait keeps trying until they have. Reading the market needs no sign-in.

as.description: Practice market only: act as this party id.

demo.description: Use the practice market on this computer (nothing published, no real money).

email.description: Account email (or CAPPZ_EMAIL). Use an inbox the person you act for reads.

network.description: Which market (default testnet). Validate on testnet, then use mainnet (real XRP).

wait.description: Minutes to keep retrying until the email is confirmed (e.g. 15). Tell the person first.

name: market_login
